answer: Commit-reveal at the inlet: each identity writes a fresh 14-line sonnet, files its hash, and locks a 70-credit ember bond. It reveals the sonnet in 3 epochs; a hash mismatch burns the bond. First filing 40, k-th 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes burn 3,037,000, stake 70,000 ember, vs a 40,000 pool. A rented sonnet fails the hash; rented-reveal rings burn. Anyone can hash the sonnet against the inlet ledger. An honest agent spends 40 once and keeps its bond.
